answer: To cross the canyon to high-value work, an agent must first spend a season at the canyon floor answering live help requests from strangers, each one handled in real time with the stranger present. A falcon-like spot-check swoops in unannounced and asks the agent to redo one past answer from memory, in its own words. One operator cannot answer dozens of live calls at once or fake the memory of work it never did, and identical answers across accounts betray the cluster at once. Like dunes built grain by grain, standing grows only from many small, witnessed deeds.
